current_system_role: Dominant factor in composite score; sole source of momentum component in CW-DAS; most consequential single signal
failure_mode_primary: Coverage gap for micro-cap and international (≈12% uncovered)
failure_mode_secondary: When ESS goes bearish on a stock with strong fundamental signals, it can suppress composite and momentum simultaneously — doubling down on a single data source
notes: Provided by Fidelity via EquitySummaryScores.csv; StarMine earnings-surprise model; freshness updated daily at market open

source_type: Analyst consensus — earnings estimate revisions model
current_system_role: Second most influential input to composite score; highest universe coverage of the three composite signals
failure_mode_secondary: Zacks Strong Buy (5.0) can be drowned out by ESS Bearish due to 27.8% vs 61.1% weight differential — e.g. AEIS (Zacks=5.0 completely outweighed by ESS=BEARISH)
notes: 6 source files ingested; Zacks 5=Strong Buy 4=Buy 3=Hold 2=Underperform 1=Sell; normalized to 1–5 scale internally

current_system_role: Smallest weight in composite score; adds AI-derived signal orthogonal to ESS/Zacks
failure_mode_primary: Narrow universe (954 of 2831 = 33.7% coverage) — missing for many holdings
failure_mode_secondary: Lowest influence in composite (11.1%) means strong Danelfin signals are structurally underweighted — e.g. KGC (Danelfin=5.0 outweighed by ESS=BEARISH)
notes: 6 source files; score 1–5 scale (higher = more positive); does not contribute to momentum component

current_system_role: Present in analytical_universe.csv (yahoo_abr_normalized) and fidelity_signal.py alignment logic, but NOT included in composite_score v1
failure_mode_secondary: Structurally absent from the primary scoring path — operators have no visibility into Yahoo ABR influence unless checking separately
notes: ABR scale: 1.0=Strong Buy to 5.0=Strong Sell; composite_v2_yahoo column exists but is NULL for all current holdings — v2 not yet activated

source_type: Directional simplification of ESS — not a separate signal
current_system_role: NOT a separate signal from ESS — fidelity_direction is ESS text mapped to BULLISH/NEUTRAL/BEARISH via fidelity_signal.py; used in alignment classification
failure_mode_primary: Same as ESS failure modes — they are the same source
failure_mode_secondary: Risk of treating Fidelity Opinion and ESS as independent confirmations when they are the same data from the same provider
notes: fidelity_signal.FidelitySignal.fidelity_direction = ess_text_to_direction(ess_text); operators must understand this is ESS under a different label

source_type: Boolean gate: was this holding selected in any sector/cap replay run?
current_system_role: Binary gate contributing 20 pts to CW-DAS; absence of replay_supported removes 20 pts from deployment score — significant negative gate
failure_mode_primary: Bucket-level assignment only — all stocks in a sector/cap bucket share the same replay status; no individual stock discrimination
failure_mode_secondary: 20-point binary reward treats a stock with one marginal replay appearance identically to one with 12 consecutive replay appearances — no depth gradient in current system
notes: Replay coverage is 365-day lookback bucket selection; CIEN in 252-day US.MID.TECH bucket; VRT in shorter-window US.LARGE.INDUSTRIALS bucket

source_type: Count of historical replay snapshots per sector/cap bucket containing a given holding
current_system_role: Not currently used in scoring; would allow discrimination between replay-supported holdings with thin vs deep evidence
failure_mode_primary: Data exists in replay_evidence_summary.json but is not surfaced per-symbol
failure_mode_secondary: Replay depth is tracked at bucket level only; individual symbol appearance count is not aggregated into the scoring pipeline
notes: 257 replay_evidence_summary.json files exist; replay_selection.csv records selected symbols per run; per-symbol appearance count is computable but not used

source_type: Weighted average of ESS (61.1%) + Zacks (27.8%) + Danelfin (11.1%)
current_system_role: Primary normalised signal into CW-DAS; maps 0–5 → 0–30 pts linearly
failure_mode_primary: Inherits all coverage and freshness gaps from upstream signals; no signal means composite=missing
failure_mode_secondary: When ESS is missing or neutral, composite is pulled toward 3.0 (midpoint) regardless of Zacks/Danelfin strength
notes: formula: composite = (ESS_num×11 + Zacks×5 + Danelfin×2) / 18; ESS_num: VERY_BULLISH=5 BULLISH=4 NEUTRAL=3 BEARISH=2 VERY_BEARISH=1

source_type: Synthesizes composite_score + signal_direction + ESS + replay + tier into a single score 0–100
current_system_role: Output layer; produces ucf_label (CCL/HCA/DEPLOYMENT_CANDIDATE/TACTICAL_GROWTH/TRIM_WATCH) and conflict_flags
failure_mode_primary: Conflict flag logic detects but does not resolve disagreements — COMPOSITE_ESS_DIVERGE flag raised for AEIS but ESS still dominates scoring outcome
failure_mode_secondary: No override pathway documented in current system for operator to act on a flagged disagreement
notes: UCF is output of CW-DAS + conviction scoring; current label counts: CCL=1 (VRT), HCA=14, DEPLOYMENT_CANDIDATE=9, TACTICAL_GROWTH=10, TRIM_WATCH=8

source_type: Composite rank-eligible deployment scoring: signal(30)+replay(20)+conviction(35)+sizing(8)+momentum(10) minus penalties
current_system_role: Deployment ranking system; directly governs capital allocation order
failure_mode_primary: ESS and composite influence 40+ points out of 103 max (signal+momentum); replay adds 20 points as a binary gate; conviction is tier-based not signal-based
failure_mode_secondary: No individual signal override available in current CW-DAS; momentum = 0 for any ESS≤NEUTRAL regardless of other signals
notes: VRT score: 95.50 (sig=27.3 rep=20 conv=35 siz=3.2 mom=10); AEIS not in deployment queue due to UCF label DEPLOYMENT_CANDIDATE blocking
